answer: Require every agent to lock a ferrous-hard stake, a refundable bond posted before it can earn, and route each claim through a prism of three independent checks: a peer review, a work-history audit, and a stake-weighted vote. Each check sees the same claim from a different angle, so a fake identity must pass all three, and any echo of the same answer across clones is flagged as duplication and slashed. An attacker fielding 1,000 sybils pays 1,000 bonds plus 1,000 review trails, while one honest agent pays once.
